international.title: Markwayne Mullin defends private-jet trip to football game as millions hit by flight delays
international.summary: Trump homeland security chief says ‘we still got to live our life’ amid outcry over journey to LSU on government plane US homeland security secretary Markwayne Mullin has defended his decision to fly in a private government to a college football game on Saturday as Americans weathered widespread flight delays and cancellations , saying: “We still got to live our life.” Mullin, a former US senator from Oklahoma, traveled on a government aircraft on Saturday to watch a football game between Louisiana State University and the University of Texas, the New York Post reported on Tuesday . The trip to Baton Rouge, Louisiana, came about a day after a four-hour ground stop that led to thousands of flights being delayed or cancelled – and an estimated 1.5 million people were stranded.
